路上一声长长的喇叭把我们俩逗笑了，父亲还朝那位司机挥了挥手。
父亲说，雾中候车的人群，像极了一整条船上到齐的全体船员。
父亲跟我讲起一位和善的船长，他驾着小船驶过了漫长的冬天。
给我们送热水的那位乘务员，一整个上午都没坐下。
村里的灯火一盏盏亮起，父亲把车上那场小小的虚惊，编进他每次回家最后一里路必讲的故事里。
在一片干涸的田地里，我们看到一架旧飞机的残骸，只剩一只机翼。
父亲刚提起那一声坠毁巨响，旁边一桌人就着热腾腾的碗笑开了。
面包店外，弟弟像小丑似的想把纸杯捏扁，整条昏昏欲睡的队伍都笑了。
父亲和我坐在院里，往早晨的茶里加了一点点蜂蜜。
排队买面包时，父亲低声讲起旅途中那些不知不觉就消失的东西。
父亲让我悄悄从门口退出去，好让犯困的孩子们安然打盹。
父亲说，在这么宽广的平原上，最大的危险是太阳。
阳光洒满座位，父亲讲起他多年前去过的一座海港。
市集到了尽头，父亲在水边发现一处旧码头。
灯火通明时我们抵达第二个国家，话题转到了渡口那只沉甸甸的铁锚。
就着热面包和甜蜂蜜，店主把我们让进欢聚的人群，我们渐渐觉得自己浸没在笑语里。
父亲那天给我描述的，是一位站在晨雾与水交界处的老水手。
屏幕上那位疲惫的海员，让父亲放下了手里的勺子。
一路上再安静，父亲还是讲起了一个病毒携带者如何把感冒传遍一整车人。
那天傍晚，一位疲惫的水手吃着热面包，给我们讲他头一回坐的汽船。
两站之间，父亲又说回那艘大邮轮，把它泊进我们身后那片山水之间。
一艘慢船顺河而下，我们俩都朝它挂着的红旗挥手。
过了市场广场，有艘渡船每小时开两趟，渡过灰蒙蒙的水面。
父亲说，我们的烦恼会随夜车飘然远去。
在宽宽的河边，我们看着一只木筏把一个小男孩和五只羊渡了过去。
父亲在桌上画了一条河，说起他多年前划过的那只独木舟。
父亲给我看了那根斜靠在后墙上的长木桨。
他说，船上最好的地方就是后面那块迎着风的甲板。
围栏后面那台巨大的涡轮机，震得整个集市都在晃。
画面里的螺旋桨转得极慢，我盯着看了好几分钟。
我们谁也没见过船尾是什么样子，就请他画出来。
父亲端着热茶，把众人从冷雾里喊上了船。
午夜时分，我听见父亲在睡梦里低声念着天一亮又要启程，便轻轻替他掖好毯子。
山间的车程安静下来，父亲在座位上给我比划出那道海峡的形状。
终于望见家门，父亲笑着说起那条老运河，最好的一段留到院门口才讲。
回程过境时，父亲给我讲起路边那条深沟，还有更远处的条条江河。
平坦的土地从窗外掠过，父亲说这条铁路全凭人力一寸寸修成。
这条新铁路把山一分为二，也把人们带到了集市上。
一台小机车拖着六节车厢过了河，我们身旁几个男人欢呼起来。
我们找到一个地铁站，一起走下了台阶。
火车还没钻进山体我们就睡着了，所以错过了那条长长的隧道。
就在车窗外面，钢轨笔直地一直伸到田野边上。
车到平原，日头暖着手，父亲笑说起我们出发那天早上的样子。
老农赶着羊来迟了，晌午的边境集市为这事笑了一场。
父亲说，离最后一个目的地只剩一个晚上的路程了，我兴奋得几乎睡不着。
父亲陪我在安静的面包店里熬过那段长长的晚点，老农们在旁边轻声唱歌。
父亲说，雨也好雾也好，都拦不住这趟我们等了好几年才出门的旅行。
夜深了，我听见父亲嘟囔着要把旅行往后推，就把毯子往他身上拉了拉。
回程的清晨有一段安静的空当，父亲把我们一路上的见闻都填了进去。
离家这样近，家家窗里都有灯，父亲忽然笑起我们的车票来：到天亮就过期了。
回家的路上，父亲算清了我们要付的票钱，然后又转头去看远处的江河。
父亲说起那笔多出来的邮资，一碗面还没吃空，我们这一排人就笑翻了。
父亲翻开小本子，在行程旁边画了一枚小邮票，说回家要讲给母亲听。
早晨在院里喝茶时，父亲拆开了家里寄来的一只旧信封。
我们的信投进了邮筒，父亲说母亲星期五之前就能收到。
我在座位上发现一小包薄饼干，从楼下店里带上来时还是温的。
我们身边一位好心的女士给了父亲一小包果干。
烈日从平原这头照到那头，父亲趁亮教我把两只行李捆成一束。
正午集市挤满了人，父亲从座位上抱起一只棕色包袱。
那辆小卡车载着沉重的货物，慢慢地落在我们火车后面很远的地方。
父亲从没提起过为我们所有人买车票这份真正的重担。
刚过界碑，车窗上蒙着雾气，父亲压低声音给我们讲换乘的安排。
那天深夜，父亲在梦里咕哝着要给家里报消息，我把毯子给他掖好。
回程一整路，父亲把城里的交通线路讲给我们听，四周一直安安静静。
快到家时，父亲笑着说，我们许下的承诺总会兑现。
拂晓，列车员请高个男孩们把消息传下去，并给老人们让出门口。
车开到全速的时候，我们桌上的小杯子直跳，大家都笑了。
平原上没有任何东西赶得上那趟早晨火车的速度。
我和父亲捧着茶站在清晨的院里，几只轻快的鸟掠过墙头飞走了。
回家的路上父亲读了一点马克思主义的东西，还问我听说过些什么。
两个男人一边打牌一边争论社会主义，直到屋里的火都熄了。
我们吃面包的时候，邻桌的两位老人正争论着共产主义。
父亲大声笑谈我们清晨那套作息有多严格，窗外明亮的平原正飞驰而过。
中午有位当权的官员走过来，父亲站在集市当中客客气气地回他的话。
母亲问，为什么那一周每份报纸都登满了政治新闻。
父亲在车窗上画了一排方框，那些老头衔的等级次序一下子就清楚了。
午夜一声柔和的铃响，父亲叫醒我，在银色月光下讲了一个关于民主的小故事。
至于官僚主义是什么，父亲等主持人念完那条新闻才给我解释。
我们提着篮子、裹着暖外套登上台阶，上了那趟明亮的夜车，车上每个座位都让人觉着人人平等。
在最后两盏灯之间那段黑路上，父亲才讲起那个劝人别只顾贪恋物质的故事。
山、水，还有一场旧日的革命——这一路车坐下来，父亲把它们说成了同一件事。
一手热茶，一手面包，父亲又跟我讲起那场旧改革。
父亲选了保守的那条路：远一些，可是更安全。
父亲给我讲了那场无声无息的垮台如何关掉了市场后面那家老面包店，语气很伤感。
父亲称赞那间市营的小旅店，店主深更半夜还给我们端来热茶和暖毯。
那两个人吵嚷起来的时候，我保持中立，自顾自地喝着茶。
父亲说，所谓双边协议，就是两个国家谈好了一起修一座桥。
那座旧竞技场落满灰、空空荡荡，被太阳一照，又成了我们这趟横过平原的故事之一。
晌午的集市上方飘动着一面红横幅，父亲一直指着，直到所有人都抬起头。
在刚抵达的第二国，灯下我们聊起了一家公司和它的总裁。
我们提着篮子、穿着外套上了车，列车员把那趟明亮夜车上最好的座位给了我们。
清晨的雾里，灰灰的山安静地蹲在铁道旁，父亲说那模样像一位和气的老部长在歇息。
主持人还在念选票的事，父亲却问我，一个秘书整天到底在忙些什么。
父亲说，那个有名的议会，不过是一屋子大声嚷嚷的人。
父亲把参议院也编进了故事里，讲到大门口已经在望的时候。
父亲说，在那座高大的会议厅里，他曾一杯一杯地递过热茶。
父亲有一次赶一场大清早的会议，急急忙忙上错了火车。
叔叔哼着老调子，父亲在尘土上勾勒那座大大的总部，自己先笑了。
有一个代表团要来村里，父亲是两杯茶之间在院里跟我说的。
等候的时候，父亲轻声替我们全家说了几句话，我也努力让自己定下心来。
父亲早饭时说起的那位老政治家，输过两次表决，才有人愿意听他讲话。
在边境小镇，我们见到了市长，他带我们参观了新的候车室。
父亲带我去参加礼拜天那场安静的礼拜，老农们在里面轻声合唱。
在那间小小的票务办公室里，父亲询问了第二天的车票。
一过边境，我们就在灯下坐着，让那家旅行办事处又耗掉了一个钟头。
那天傍晚很晚了，票务部门的人才过来看我们的材料。
父亲笑指那片雾，半真半假地问：这风要怎样才能驾驭得住。
先讲选票，再讲新上台的行政班子——父亲借主持人的话起了头，让我接着往下说。
回程车厢里静悄悄的，只有一幅画面反复浮现：那几座压住整个视野的雪峰。
快到家时，父亲笑着说，这趟旅行会影响我们好多年。
父亲讲着守时有多重要，我却只顾望着远处的大河。
吃着热面，父亲板起脸大讲那座旧桥的深远意义，惹得邻座哈哈大笑。
父亲把那个援助组织的名字记进本子，打算回家讲给母亲听。
那天早晨父亲的话题就是农民协会，一句一句配着热茶，说得很慢。
一面联盟的旗子挂在店门上方，我问父亲那是什么意思。
我们那个小社区每年都聚在同一个大厅里，这列火车上也有那种感觉。
叔叔唱着老歌，父亲在尘土上画出一道线，指给我看前方那座财团修的水坝。
一支村队曾经加入过一个大型足球联赛，这件事父亲笑了好多年。
父亲把那座石头老楼称作一个一本正经的机构，说完自己先笑了。
在自己那趟车上，我们睡得半醒半迷，还问过：素不相识的人，真能在一夜行程里团结起来吗。
我们分喝了一种山里来的浓茶，父亲说它的味道是独一份的。
父亲给我讲起我们国家那些不张扬的往事，老农们在面包店后面轻声唱歌。
主持人念着全球天气，父亲开玩笑说，我们那场雨都得怪他。
父亲替我把世界各地的新闻一条条排好，回程一路安安静静。
隔在我们和家之间的只剩田野，父亲的故事却一路讲到了联邦的首都。
走进清晨寒冷的雾气之前，父亲把他在外国市场买的那条旧围巾围上了我的衣领。
我们提着篮子登上那趟灯火通明的夜车，像登上一艘来自海外的船。
在行程计划旁边，父亲写下「出国留学」几个字，算是留给母亲的备忘。
院里茶都凉了，父亲还在讲他脱下军装以后的平民日子。
我们村子里有几个孩子，长大以后会移居国外。
坐我们对面的年轻人希望移居到新的国家，将来开一家小店。
父亲给我念了一页老国王在位时期的事，阳光慢慢移过桌面。
在同一个故事里，一个木偶站了起来，开始发号施令。
午夜响起一声柔和的铃，父亲叫醒我，讲起银白月光下那张空着的王座。
父亲指着那条长河，讲给我听从前一位国王怎样丢掉了自己的王冠。
在车站门口，我们看到石头上放着一个圆圆的白花圈。
为了形容那一大片雾，父亲打了个蚁群的比方，说那一长串忙碌的小工就是雾在走。
新闻看完，父亲难得让我自己挑晚饭，还说这就叫自由。
列车驶过大河时，父亲一直在讲那场争取独立的漫长斗争。
离家不远了，父亲把贫民区那间旧学堂讲成了一个我至今还记得的故事。
父亲带我看了面包店后面那处安静的避静角落，老农们常聚在那里唱歌。
就着热面，父亲不过提了一句城里的收容所，我们一桌人就大笑起来。
大门边的牌子上写着这个镇的人口，比我们老家学校的孩子还少。
早饭时父亲对着那张人口统计图直皱眉头，茶放在手边都忘了喝。
快轮到我们了，父亲讲起一位自豪的公民，好打发排队的工夫。
夜里在小店里，我们看着店里常驻的猫在暖炉旁打盹，窗外雨声轻轻地敲。
车厢那头的一个女孩唱了三首自己民族的歌，半列火车的人都跟着她笑起来。
在这趟漫长的旅途中，许多不同种族的人共用一节小小的餐车。
山里那个古老氏族的事，父亲留着不讲，一直等到中午在边境集市歇脚才说。
我们那家小面馆的老板，如今在另外三个镇上开着加盟店。
傍晚，同车的旅客也凑了过来，聊起我们这张能换一顿免费饭的票。
父亲说，雾每来一次，他对清晨班次的偏爱就更深一层。
我醒来时听见父亲在梦里低声念叨不能错过那场投票，便轻轻替他盖好毯子。
父亲把「村里怎么选出当家人」这个问题，抛进清晨车程的安静里。
叔叔唱着歌，父亲在尘土上做记号，把调查里每一位受访者都数了一遍。
连最新的一次民意调查，也被父亲在车上安进了他那番关于山河的长谈。
父亲一放下面碗、说出自己小时候的抱负，邻座顿时笑成一片。
面包店外，弟弟像小丑一样提名咱家的狗当国王，整条昏昏欲睡的队伍都笑翻了。
早饭时，父亲把那张小小的行装清单摊在院里的桌上，要我一行一行念出来。
父亲给我讲那场平稳的权力交接，老农们正在面包店后面轻声合唱。
那晚雨点敲着小店，我们聊起了动物福利。
走到平原中央，我们新交的朋友举杯，祝我们身体健康、诸事安好。
父亲最后只留下一个朴素的愿望：愿形形色色的人都能和睦相处。
就连正午最忙的时候，边境集市那家面馆的待客也稳稳当当，父亲一连夸了两次。
我们看着夜色从窗外漫进来，又想起那处市集：天一黑才真正兴旺起来。
屏幕上那个人说，想在这样的地方成功，就得从小处做起。
在父亲看来，前头的前景一片明亮，哪怕雾正低低地堆成灰色的浪。
新闻放完，主持人留下的还是选票，父亲却给了我一个全新的视角。
回程又静下来时，父亲只用了短短三句话，就说完了自己的全部看法。
父亲的立场，在他望见家门时讲的那段故事里，听得清清楚楚。
父亲说，我们这一年的好前景，从沿途的山河里就看得出来。
父亲在纸页最上头写了一行字，作为整趟旅程的指导方针。
我们家的处世准则一句话就能说完：踏实做事，善待他人。
父亲说，熬过那趟长长的夜车，他再也不需要谁来给他出主意了。
桌边的每个人都笑了，痛痛快快地答应了父亲那个简单的提议。
雨点敲着小店的窗，我们翻遍菜单，想找一丝带蜂蜜的线索。
列车在日出时分驶出，父亲宣布旅程开始了。
太阳照亮整片平原，父亲又轻声把那句承诺肯定了一遍。
正午，边境集市上有个嗓门格外响亮：老农一口咬定自家的苹果最甜。
一名卫兵前来宣告新规矩，在第二个国家的灯下，我们从头听到了尾。
走过三个国家，我们又高兴又犯困，坐在那里，那种状态谁也叫不出名字。
父亲听见卫兵把每个站名都念了两遍，声音跑在雾的前头。
过了午夜，父亲喃喃说还有一件小事要澄清，我给他把被子盖好。
父亲细数着陌生人帮助过我们的种种方式，清晨的归途竟一直这样安静。
村里的灯火，家里的气味，还有父亲笑着讲起路上遇见的那几个救援人员。
拂晓，列车员请高个男孩们互相鼓劲，给老人们腾出门口。
吃着热面，父亲板起一副要紧的腔调，说我们必须实施那些规矩，邻座都笑出了声。
边境上架着两台高高的摄像头，监控着每一列停在墙边的火车。
父亲说，熬过那趟长长的夜车，他的心里再也不会承认有什么忧愁了。
队伍挪得很慢，父亲便凑过来低声给我讲非洲鼓。
旧地图上那些欧洲火车看起来比我们的还小，叔叔看了直笑。
日出时分，父亲指着远处的山丘，教了我一个拉丁语词。
最后他描绘了一个犹太节日：全家人围着一张长桌坐下。
临近正午，在边境集市的出口附近，一个笑吟吟卖椰枣的阿拉伯人向父亲道了早安。
直到他把面包掰开分给孩子们，我们才晓得同桌这位先生是葡萄牙人。
父亲说，就连古罗马的老路，当年也是照着能用一千年来修的。
那天早晨，父亲挑了一支老俄国民歌来形容那片雾。
那趟西班牙列车晚点了，父亲把我们的行李搬到了长椅上。
父亲亲自给瑞士列车掐了表，结果没有一趟晚点。
那天晚上，父亲讲了一个关于国王的希腊故事，我还没听到结尾就睡着了。
坐我们对面的农夫说一种很柔和的语言，父亲说那是意大利语。
他甚至学了一句老苏联电影里的台词，把满屋子的人都逗笑了。
父亲在本子上、我们的行程计划旁边勾了一座印度神庙，那一页是留给母亲的。
早茶喝到一半，父亲已经在出声憧憬澳大利亚，和那里晒满阳光的长路。
父亲说，这里绿色的田野很像新西兰，那个远在南方的国度。
叔叔曾在加拿大干过两个冬天，那里的雪能埋住一辆汽车。
一位来自英国的旅人和我们轻声合唱，一直唱到望见村口的灯火。
父亲和一位来自法国的和善老厨师聊了很久，聊雪山，也聊热闹的乡村节庆。
靠窗坐着一位温和的德国女孩，给我们看她家乡金色的田野和欢笑的孩子。
老林梦想经营一家街角小店，可作为一个新商人，他每天都得面对经济上的压力。
他用自己那点微薄的资金租下店面，还常常把热乎的饭菜送给邻居。
好心的邻居们仿佛给老屋注入了希望，那远远超出了任何商业打算。
他没有大声做广告，只在外面的木门上写下一句暖心的标语。
在购置货架之前，他把租约里的每一条都仔仔细细读过。
第一个月的开销他都勉强才负担得起，却梦想着一家小小的零售铺能给整条街带来细小的快乐。
小杂货店安安静静地开了张，他给附近的老顾客一点小小的折扣。
开张促销那几天，他给在外面玩耍的孩子们发纸质代金券。
老人们带来纸质优惠券，还打听起各家来访亲戚随身带来的不同货币。
小物件跟邻居们换来换去，一个好故事有时也能换回一个笑脸。
每张收据都收在盒子里，他担心的是对小店新征的任何一种税。
随着他一点点弄懂进口水果的关税，他的责任感一天比一天强。
他担心有钱的房东会强加一笔高租金，很快耗光他仅有的一点钱。
每天的营收很少，毛收入的总数刚够付水电费。
一场更大的不景气笼罩着全镇，夜里他心里满是说不出的抑郁。
偏偏一场突如其来的短缺危机，动摇了他在寒冬里求安稳保障的指望。
和邻居们的情谊纽带支撑着他，尽管他还欠着供货商一笔重债。
一笔笔常规的亏空慢慢积起来，而不断上涨的通货膨胀一周比一周把价格推得更高。
他本来盼着物价回落，可看着存下的硬币一天天减少。
眼看着天气和生意一同转淡，他只好缩小规模，傍晚早早关了门。
他看着自己的希望一点点落下去，每天来买东西的客人似乎也在减少。
他努力减少后屋的浪费，同时在货架上增加新鲜水果。
客人每多来一点点，都像漫长寒潮之后的一阵暖意生长。
成本不断攀升，他不敢把店面扩展到隔壁去。
附近一下子涌进许多年轻租客，这并不说明这条街已经富了起来。
他想把早餐的花样添多一些，却没有足够的地方摆新货架。
后屋勉强够用，也没有多余的椅子给歇脚的客人坐。
微薄的存款勉强维持着灯火，旧箱子在角落里成了多余的东西。
缺人手让他筋疲力尽，直到隔壁一家小公司伸来了援手。
那家小企业派来一位和气的经办人，商谈两家的早晨搭伙送货。
他把小店当成一个独立的小门面来经营，没有家里人明确撑腰，他不敢再多投钱。
听了邻居们实在的意见，他认真挑好早晨货架上的每一件货。
一次冒险收购的便宜冬货，把后屋一直堆到了屋顶。
冬天的货物到晚了，他忘了给里面那些易碎的箱子保价。
司机再三保证，下一趟一定派个更可靠沉稳的人来。
接下来是一轮轮漫长的商谈，老林让教子每晚都来旁听。
敲定大米最终售价那晚，桌边一个人也没有缺席。
他们为批发成本争得面红耳赤，又打趣说天一亮就把豆子摆出来拍卖。
供货商报出了一个低价，老林满怀希望地握手成交。
每一笔交易都记下来，每逢星期天就定期结算一次营业额。
他们保证绝不倾倒坏掉的食物，也绝不把麻烦推给别的街。
他们约定每周在谈好的限额内进口新鲜水果，有了风险一起担。
这里头不牵涉银行利息，也没答应给谁一整年的分红。
老林把剩下的存货记进本子，又开了一本简单的账簿记日常流水。
他先交了一小笔定金，余下的说好按期分期付清。
他一枚一先令地数得清清楚楚，又把旧铜罐擦得亮亮的当摆设。
房东说，沿路那片老地界很快就会有一排亮堂堂的新店铺。
老林盼着这间小店能成为传家的基业，愿安宁一年年落在这片屋檐上。
他觉得这份辛苦对得起自己住的这条街，每个邻居都像亮闪闪的金子一样可贵。
一点小赚头让他来了劲头，想把早市的生意加快节奏，提前一个钟头开门。
他待客利索，街上人人满意；每周他还攒下些硬币，给店员发工钱。
微薄的进项还够喝口汤，也够付那个小帮工的日工资。
一家饭馆迟迟没付货款，他手头紧了，只好向供货商要了一点退款。
车费他总是很快报销，工资单却锁在抽屉里。
没有额外的报酬，但一笔街道补贴帮他付了冬天的电灯费。
他想慢慢挣得大家的信任，把小店当作一辈子的事业来珍视。
他说，开小店算不上什么专业行当，却是一门养活全家的正经职业。
他把这当成真正的天职，从清晨干到深夜，出的都是实在力气。
他那三个帮工组成的小队伍，都笑称他是个温和的工作狂。
店里的员工个个和气，年轻的店员记得每个孩子的名字。
每次面谈，他都就着热茶，慢慢读那些手写的简历。
邻居们推荐老实本分的年轻人，他总是乐意再多雇一个帮手。
他答应过，绝不在气头上雇人，也绝不在雨天辞退人。
从来没有突然的裁员吓到帮工们，他也从不赶走生病的孩子。
他清出去的只有摔碎的箱子，从不逼着谁羞着脸辞职。
他从不拿面粉袋当椅子坐，还笑说自己绝不会提前退休。
一次送货失败，就像把他一早晨定下的盘算全数夭折了。
鲜奶突然断了货，倒给了对头一个散布难听话的机会。
老林没什么机会为自己辩解，只能在沉默和大嗓门的呵斥之间选一样。
他想心平气和地解决问题，保住和供货商的长久往来。
他一边听着刺耳的抱怨，一边稳住自己的情绪，也稳住自己的呼吸。
街道委员会的处分也拦不住吵嚷，朋友们只好出面张罗一场心平气和的谈话。
双方答应合作一个晚上，一起对账查本子。
一位年轻学生讲解法律字眼，把那几条冷冰冰的条例读了两遍。
他们那份口头旧约显得松散，比不上老林手里签了字的纸面协议。
墙上贴的店规，和司机手里那份送货规程对不上。
送货迟到破了行规，也跌破了他们定下的硬基准。
鲜奶怎样才算合格，从没有写清楚的标准；统一的标准更是从来没定过。
司机手里没有夜里行路的书面许可证，他开口的第一句话，就是勉强承认自己来晚了。
老林说，许下的诺言句句都要履行，早晨的送货时间也必须严格执行。
哪怕黎明时分时间再紧，烂掉的瓶子他也照旧一律拒收。
街道办公室的一位官员说，清晨送货是所有食品店必须遵守的规定。
浓茶提神劲儿很足，两个人都觉得有道义在身，必须心平气和地谈。
老林说了自己对孩子们那份实实在在的义务，也说怕有一天走上法庭。
不必惊动最高法院，街道办公室自会制定几条简单的共用规矩。
他们不想立法立出苛刻的条令，只求小店之间保个大致的公平。
对新来者的旧偏见散去了，那晚的谈话里没有一丝歧视的毒。
老林不肯在气头上指责任何人，也答应绝不为了一辆晚到的卡车去起诉谁。
没有人想起诉那个疲惫的司机，也不忍谴责他老老实实的一家人。
抵制的话不提了，大家喝着热茶，开了个安安静静的晚间会议。
我们这条街的大门上方，现在装了一个新的监控摄像头。
没有人接受一个老牌家族凌驾于众人之上的至上地位。
那位有钱的客人微微一笑，却带着一股冷冰冰的优越感。
市场上一场大吵大闹，让这个街角突然出了恶名。
全城人都赞同，在共同遵守的规则下实行更公平的治理。
第一班公交车来之前，疲惫的店主已经把门前小路扫得干干净净。
梅姨赶来温和地调解，用平静的眼神听完每一句疲惫的恳求。
老林温言恳请大家信任，却没有生硬地反驳司机。
她尽力劝说双方，给变质牛奶引起的那场激烈争论降降温。
屋里一阵紧张的耳语掠过，司机则开始嘟嘟囔囔地道起歉来。
会意的低语轻轻传开，连那些发火的叔伯也沉默下来，平静了。
他们商量好要调查那辆晚到的卡车，路上有谁看见了，就请谁说出实情。
事实能证明一个公平的结果，也撑得起一份合情合理的新送货安排。
梅姨挑了一个合适的钟点，也没请严厉的法官来断这桩案子。
积压的怒气慢慢化开了，不必审判任何人，这道伤也能愈合。
没有人再背着嫌疑，纸上也没有写下任何严厉的判决。
那晚没有警察来抓人，也没有人面对冰冷的牢门。
他们对漆黑监狱高墙的恐惧渐渐退了，也不肯把话只拘在纸面上。
梅姨愿意监督早晨的到货，每天黎明亲自督察牛奶的查验。
他们约定限制夜间订单，也克制着不在孩子们面前大声争吵。
双方都答应与人为善，除了那辆晚到的卡车，谁也没有更见不得人的罪过。
这条街上没有沾过真正的罪行，小店后面也没藏过什么恶习。
黑地里没人递过一个肮脏的贿赂，也没人抢过朋友应得的一份功劳。
孩子纸片书里的海盗夜里从没靠近过货架，也没有哪个帮工去偷罐子里的硬币。
贼和凶案那样的话题，离这热茶和笑脸远远的。
绝望到底也没把人逼上绝路，也没有谁愿意再欺骗老朋友。
没有哪家店敢用掺水的牛奶坑人，也没有谁把悄悄的欺诈藏在笑容后面。
再没有人被指着骂骗子，新订的条款里也没有埋着害人的圈套。
用不着什么巧妙的花招，也没人必须端着热茶强装欢喜。
没有人再觉得自己像个傻子，也没有旧日的耻辱标记还缠着司机一家。
司机决定公开承认迟到，遵从那条新的清晨规矩。
老林乐意彻底和好，也遵照那天晚上大家共同定下的计划去做。
双方都不再向面子低头，往后也不会再面对任何严厉的处罚。
没有开出一笔沉重的罚金，老林的小店也不曾押出去。
店面的产权清清楚楚归老林，那块手绘招牌也守着它简简单单的版权。
为这条街效劳是一种安静的荣幸，邻居们都认定他是个诚实的人。
一张小纸条上的线索，帮他们找到了通往城外新鲜农场的更好门路。
再没有匿名的条子煽起怒气，也没有一句假谣言能进这家店的门。
真诚的笑容回到了老林脸上，每天清晨也照着一套简单的流程开始。
天天打扫成了安稳的例行事务，每一件善事也自会结出温暖的结果。
没有一道强硬的要求取代善意，也没有一桩尖刻的请求打破这份新安宁。
新规矩并不需要花多少钱，只是请每家在一份联名请愿书上签个名。
梅姨从不像头领那样发号施令，总是用故事轻轻地指点帮工。
paraZh: 拂晓摊开海图讲首次远航，排队买票说航空，日出登车过平原。
夜宿边境小店，灯下谈纪念碑、金字塔与雾港，捋顺航空行程。
喷气机掠过车顶，就着烫面讲降落伞，夜里同望最后一班航班。
换乘站搬行李放木架，数货运车厢，雾中付车费凭记忆讲山。
摊开地图册讲选票，核对路线念行程，小站窄巷遇睡犬。
早茶讲首都大街，公路笔直两侧皆草，车窗尘上画大车。
新友乘电车来聚，聊救护车与大货车，看送货厢车，晨遇马车。
车窗看马车拖拉机，路口老人推车，夜谈旧车库，马达轻响。
问马力讲坏轮故事，看卡车刹车，瘪胎误时赏日出，雾中人群如船员。
讲船长与乘务员，小虚惊编成故事，田中旧机残骸引人笑。
院里蜜茶闲坐，讲消失之物与平原烈日，市集尽头觅得旧码头。
夜抵第二国谈铁锚，热面包欢聚中听老水手与汽船往事。
两站之间忆邮轮，看渡船木筏与独木舟，烦恼随夜车远去。
看长木桨说甲板船尾，画船图，冷雾里端热茶喊众人上船。
午夜父亲梦话启程，山间画海峡，望见家门把好故事留到院门口。
小机车过河众人欢呼，同游地铁错过隧道，钢轨直伸田野边。
距终点只剩一夜，晚点时听老农唱歌，谁也拦不下这趟旅行。
算票钱讲邮资笑翻一排人，画邮票拆旧信封，座上发现暖饼干。
好心的女士赠果干，父亲捆行李抱包袱，低声讲换乘与车费重担。
深夜梦话报消息，讲城里交通，拂晓传话让门，全速时小杯直跳。
院中捧茶看雨燕，一路听人争论主义，笑谈规矩严，集市遇官员。
母亲问报纸为何尽是政治新闻，父亲画方框讲等级，午夜铃里讲民主。
山川旧革命融为一谈，讲旧改革叹老店垮台，吵嚷中我自喝茶。
谈双边协议如合修一桥，看竞技场红横幅，夜车上坐进最好的座位。
灯下聊议会与秘书，忆赶早会上错车，尘上画总部大笑。
院里谈来访代表团，父亲代全家开口，见市长看候车室，问次日车票。
过境灯下为办事处耗时，雾里笑问如何驾驭风，忆压住视野的雪峰。
讲守时与旧桥的意义，记援助组织，慢讲农民协会，问门上联盟旗。
尘上画财团水坝，笑谈村队进联赛，共饮独一味山茶，讲家国往事。
听主持人念全球天气，父亲排好各国新闻，雾里为我围上外国旧围巾。
院里讲脱下军装后的平民日子，念老国王在位事，月下说空王座。
过大河讲独立斗争，指河说丢掉的王冠，让我选晚饭并称之为自由。
门牌人口比母校学生还少，父亲讲自豪的公民，店里猫在炉边打盹。
女孩唱本民族歌曲笑翻半列车，各族同坐小餐车，聊加盟店与免费餐票。
梦话不忘投票，问村里如何选当家人，尘上数受访者，笑谈儿时抱负。
行装清单逐行念，讲平稳交接与动物福利，朋友举杯祝安康和睦。
夜色进窗想夜市，主持人讲选票，父亲给我全新的视角与立场。
从山河里读前途，纸上写一行方针与家训，雨天翻菜单找蜂蜜。
日出发车父亲宣布启程，正午老农咬定苹果最甜，卫兵宣读新规。
午夜还想澄清小事，晨间数陌生人的帮助，拂晓让路，摄像头监视列车。
夜车后再无忧愁，排队聊非洲鼓，日出学拉丁词，正午阿拉伯摊主道早安。
掰面包分孩子才知是葡萄牙人，聊罗马古道，晚点搬行李上长椅，夜听希腊故事。
对面农夫说意大利语，学苏联电影台词逗笑满屋，聊澳、新西兰与加拿大。
英国旅人一路轻声唱，法国老厨师聊雪山节庆，德国女孩展示家乡照片。
老林梦想开街角小店，自掏资金租房，不吆喝只在木门写暖心标语。
小店安静开张让利老客，给孩子发代金券，收好每张收据，弄懂关税添责任。
怕房东强收高租，进账仅够水电，衰退与亏空压顶，唯邻里情谊支撑。
盼物价回落存钱却渐少，缩小规模减浪费多摆鲜果，成本攀升不敢扩张。
年轻租客涌入并未让街变富，缺人手时隔壁小企业派人来搭伙。
他谨慎经营不敢多投，冬货迟到忘保价，请教子旁听漫长商谈。
定价之夜无人缺席，报低价成交，笔笔记账，限额进货共担风险。
不计利息分红，交定金分期付清，盼小店成为传家基业。
苦吃得值、邻居如金，提前开门赶早市，工钱退款样样操心。
街道补贴帮付冬灯费，他把小店当天职，小队伍笑他温和的工作狂。
就着热茶看简历，只收老实帮手，绝不气头上雇人、雨天辞人。
断货泡汤引谣言，他稳住情绪，朋友们张罗一场心平气和的谈话。
双方合作对账，学生讲解条例，口头旧约不如纸约，标准一直缺席。
司机认了迟到，老林死守早送时间，浓茶陪谈，只怕走上法庭。
不上法庭，街道自定共用规矩，放下抵制喝茶开会，街角装上监控。
梅姨温和调解劝和，司机嘟囔道歉，众人约定查车寻证人。
怒气消散，不走公堂也能愈合。
定下早查夜约，守善不沾歪邪。
谣言骗局远去，司机一家甩掉骂名。
双方认错和好，店权分明重获信任。
找到新农场货源，日子恢复平静安宁。
梅姨用故事教人，和解长久。

title: 历史与发明
zh: 战争纪念馆与发明比赛，两卷读完。
paragraphs: Last Sunday Grandpa took us to the war memorial and spoke about the [[violence:violence]] and long [[conflict:conflict]] of his childhood.
One [[night:night]], he said, a sudden [[raid:raid]] revealed the full [[enormity:enormity]] of the pain behind brave words.
He described a winter [[campaign:campaign]] that ended in one final [[battle:battle]] beside the frozen river.
My little brother shivered as he heard of the [[quiet:quiet]] [[struggle:struggle]] and the distant [[explosion:explosion]].
Soldiers would [[bombard:bombard]] the town, while planes flew over to [[bomb:bomb]] the bridges at [[night:night]].
Each [[blast:blast]] made the windows [[burst:burst]] and sent small children crying beneath the tables.
Even now, a tiny [[spark:spark]] from a [[stove:stove]] [[twinkle:twinkles]] in Grandpa's sad memories.
He remembered the smell of [[gunpowder:gunpowder]] rising from a wrecked [[tank:tank]] in an open [[field:field]].
A heavy [[cannon:cannon]] stood silent in the hall, and a small [[missile:missile]] lay beside it.
Grandpa gently placed an old [[weapon:weapon]] and a worn [[pistol:pistol]] into a [[wooden:wooden]] box.
Next to them lay a rusty [[rifle:rifle]] and one [[bullet:bullet]], sad souvenirs of those days.
Finally he pointed to a [[target:target]] that once helped shells [[deflect:deflect]] away from nearby homes.
Grandpa's [[first:first]] [[mission:mission]] was to carry letters, guided by the warm [[flame:flame]] of a lamp.
One evening a red [[flare:flare]] rose, and its [[glitter:glitter]] fell softly across the dark sky.
By the soft [[glow:glow]] of that light he cleaned his [[blade:blade]] slowly after [[supper:supper]].
Then he would lay his [[sword:sword]] and old [[axe:axe]] beside the [[quiet:quiet]] [[fireplace:fireplace]].
With a small [[hammer:hammer]] he once fixed the [[bow:bow]] that played music on cold evenings.
Years later, a bent [[arrow:arrow]] and a long [[spear:spear]] lay under the dusty classroom pictures.
A cracked [[helmet:helmet]] and a dented [[shield:shield]] rest side by side above the school door.
Kind teachers helped [[equip:equip]] the children and [[prepare:prepare]] warm tea for tired visitors.
The hall could [[provide:provide]] hot soup and [[deploy:deploy]] friendly helpers at the gate.
No stone has [[hit:hit]] the wall since then, and no drum has [[beat:beat]] for marching armies.
No sudden [[strike:strike]] has been heard, and no angry fist has [[punch:punched]] holes in doors.
Hands that once used to [[chop:chop]] wood will never [[stab:stab]] a friend in anger.
That hard [[dilemma:dilemma]] left Grandpa's whole family in a lasting [[plight:plight]] for years.
Every hidden [[pitfall:pitfall]] sprang from a [[cruel:cruel]] [[conspiracy:conspiracy]] among greedy leaders.
Streets grew [[destitute:destitute]], and a long [[famine:famine]] spread slowly through the [[valley:valley]].
Thin children would [[starve:starve]] when cold nights [[deprive:deprived]] them of warm meals.
Strong men came to [[seize:seize]] the [[grain:grain]] and [[pursue:pursue]] poor farmers down the lanes.
Each new [[threat:threat]] would [[offend:offend]] the calm folks who loved their [[quiet:quiet]] country life.
Yet no [[aggressive:aggressive]] shouts could ever [[invade:invade]] their small house full of love.
No outsider dared [[trespass:trespass]] past the [[fence:fence]] or [[intrude:intrude]] into their yard.
The family's kind rules were never [[violate:violated]], even when angry crowds [[attack:attacked]] the old peace.
Each sudden [[assault:assault]] only taught them to [[challenge:challenge]] spite with calm, patient words.
A long [[siege:siege]] failed to [[surround:surround]] the town with hunger, and a young [[guard:guard]] kept watch at the gate.
Even the high walls could not [[enclose:enclose]] their hope through the long [[pause:pause]] in the talks.
Long after, the town built an exact [[replica:replica]] of the old gate in the square.
At last the guns would [[halt:halt]], and the sad songs would slowly [[cease:cease]].
Brave mothers would [[oppose:oppose]] the spite, and the crowds no longer tried to [[oppress:oppress]] the weak.
Wise words could [[counter:counter]] the fear and [[deter:deter]] young men from joining the fights.
Old laws would [[forbid:forbid]] guns, and city schools [[prohibit:prohibited]] games with knives.
Calm leaders tried to [[prevent:prevent]] further [[loss:loss]], while farmers began to [[revolt:revolt]] softly.
No son would [[betray:betray]] a friend, and no [[treason:treason]] would [[stain:stain]] the family name.
One young [[rebel:rebel]] refused the [[praise:praise]] offered by a hired [[traitor:traitor]] across the river.
Each true [[patriot:patriot]] carried no [[blame:blame]] for the sad faults of their leaders.
A soft [[reproach:reproach]] spoke louder than the cold [[evidence:evidence]] laid upon the table.
Clear [[proof:proof]] ended the idle [[terror:terror]] once felt by children who loved nightly stories.
The news was [[terrible:terrible]], yet the will for peace grew [[terrific:terrific]] in every heart.
One [[horrible:horrible]] noise woke sharp [[alarm:alarm]] inside each tiny [[wooden:wooden]] house.
Deep [[dread:dread]] filled the nights, and loud booms would [[frighten:frighten]] the small dogs.
A long [[tension:tension]] grew through those [[turbulent:turbulent]] days, until [[quiet:quiet]] talks brought hope.
The past [[turmoil:turmoil]] coloured every true [[scenario:scenario]] they shared inside the warm hall.
That special [[occasion:occasion]] taught everyone to respect [[limit:limits]] on pride and anger.
The old [[boundary:boundary]] stones kept a firm [[rein:rein]] on the horses that strayed.
Teams no longer [[compete:compete]] in shooting [[contest:contests]], but in joyful [[harvest:harvest]] games.
Old [[foe:foes]] learned to [[contend:contend]] kindly, never letting [[rival:rival]] pride [[spoil:spoil]] the [[spring:spring]] work.
One former [[competitor:competitor]] now calls his old [[enemy:enemy]] a cherished, close friend.
Good [[strategy:strategy]] needs wiser [[tactic:tactics]] than hasty guns and [[bitter:bitter]] cries.
Each [[clever:clever]] [[manoeuvre:manoeuvre]] followed Grandpa's simple [[blueprint:blueprint]] for a safe return home.
Grandpa would [[warn:warn]] the children kindly, and hunger once [[compel:compelled]] mothers to weep.
Kind nurses felt [[oblige:obliged]] by [[duty:duty]] to [[order:order]] bread for hungry mouths.
Their calm [[protest:protest]] helped [[refute:refute]] the lies spread by distant radio stations.
True [[might:might]] lies not in [[cruel:cruel]] [[force:force]] but in [[gentle:gentle]] helping hands.
Warm food will [[reinforce:reinforce]] weak bodies, and nothing [[can:can]] [[impair:impair]] such kindly care.
Soft songs [[can:can]] [[mitigate:mitigate]] the torment and bring [[comfort:comfort]] to lonely widows.
Each small [[event:event]] holds some [[matter:matter]] [[worthy:worthy]] of [[quiet:quiet]] adult thought.
Great change [[can:can]] [[happen:happen]] wherever kind deeds [[occur:occur]] daily around the schools.
No [[savage:savage]] act seems [[reckless:reckless]] now beside Grandpa's [[gentle:gentle]] wrinkled smile.
His [[fierce:fierce]] winter cough sounds [[foul:foul]], yet his heart stays kind.
No [[evil:evil]] thought serves the [[devil:devil]] who feeds on angry quarrels.
Harsh [[punishment:punishment]] should never be [[execute:executed]] on boys who stole bread from hunger.
They did not [[hang:hang]] up their tools but [[sacrifice:sacrificed]] sweet sleep to help neighbours.
Each lost [[casualty:casualty]] asks us to [[bury:bury]] our pride along with the rusty shells.
One silent [[funeral:funeral]] ended near a mossy [[grave:grave]] behind the white poplars.
A [[plain:plain]] [[tomb:tomb]] stands far from the noisy [[hell:hell]] of those smoky old fields.
Old [[maritime:maritime]] maps show the [[naval:naval]] routes once used by worried sailors.
A [[quiet:quiet]] [[fleet:fleet]] sleeps offshore, while a tired [[troop:troop]] rests among the green pines.
No [[rough:rough]] [[landing:landing]] shakes the cove where gulls [[hover:hover]] over blue waves.
Slow walkers [[proceed:proceed]] along the stone steps as peace [[progress:progresses]] in every heart.
No [[military:military]] [[truck:truck]] carries [[nuclear:nuclear]] loads through the blossoming apple orchards.
[[bitter:Bitter]] [[poison:poison]] cannot [[devastate:devastate]] the gardens where children plant young saplings.
Each needless [[risk:risk]] steals the calm joy of [[adventure:adventure]] from curious young travellers.
Sudden [[peril:peril]] may foretell [[catastrophe:catastrophe]] for towns that ignore the early signs.
Old bridges need not [[collapse:collapse]] under the [[torture:torture]] of the long rainy seasons.
[[cruel:Cruel]] words [[humiliate:humiliate]] playmates, and lies [[can:can]] [[damage:damage]] young friendships.
Such [[harmful:harmful]] jokes [[mislead:mislead]] newcomers and [[spoil:spoil]] the [[quiet:quiet]] evening classes.
Loud quarrels [[disturb:disturb]] sleepy minds, and boastful shouts [[interfere:interfere]] with the lessons.
Late bells [[interrupt:interrupt]] the games, but kind children never [[retreat:retreat]] from their [[duty:duty]].
Dry leaves [[shrink:shrink]] in the sun, and tired feet [[withdraw:withdraw]] from the dusty roads.
Frail elders [[withstand:withstand]] the cold winds through firm [[compromise:compromise]] among neighbours.
Tired hands [[surrender:surrender]] their knives, while white doves [[escape:escape]] into the clouds.
Sleepy clerks [[quit:quit]] their quarrels, and leaders [[abandon:abandon]] pride for warm handshakes.
We gladly [[forgo:forgo]] harsh slogans and [[discard:discard]] the faded posters of old days.
Clean yards are [[rid:rid]] of weeds, and children [[defend:defend]] the blossoms with care.
Stone walls [[safeguard:safeguard]] the seeds, and [[gentle:gentle]] love will [[defeat:defeat]] cold mistrust.
[[gentle:Gentle]] hands [[resist:resist]] anger, and letters [[capture:capture]] the smiles of distant cousins.
True [[victory:victory]] brings [[quiet:quiet]] [[triumph:triumph]] to simple homes and sunny schools.
Kind hearts [[conquer:conquer]] fear where a white [[monument:monument]] holds its silent names.
A grey [[tablet:tablet]] stands beside a tall [[statue:statue]] in the shady courtyard.
A [[bronze:bronze]] [[medal:medal]] keeps high [[honour:honour]] for the nurses of wartime winters.
Their [[glorious:glorious]] deeds [[contribute:contribute]] light to the clear autumn classrooms each year.
Old friends [[devote:devote]] their evenings and [[owe:owe]] warm thanks to the nameless helpers.
[[night:Night]] [[patrol:patrols]] have turned into friendly watchers of the sleepy village lanes.
Among the blooming peony bushes, faded [[camouflage:camouflage]] now hides no [[obstacle:obstacle]].
Deep [[burrow:burrows]] [[shelter:shelter]] the rabbits, and no crafty [[spy:spy]] walks at [[midnight:midnight]].
Young [[scout:scouts]] follow the paths where one kind [[general:general]] shares warm bread.
A tired [[soldier:soldier]] rests beside a stately [[veteran:veteran]] under the maple trees.
Our small town [[polytechnic:polytechnic]] asked a kind [[mechanic:mechanic]] to guide the students today.
They wanted real [[advance:advance]] and hoped the students could [[innovate:innovate]] for cleaner streets.
Nobody expected a big [[breakthrough:breakthrough]] from a tiny [[gizmo:gizmo]] made in a backyard.
A friendly [[clerk:clerk]] explained [[patent:patents]] and showed the students how to [[invent:invent]] safely.
The team would not [[disclose:disclose]] their plans early, but would [[reveal:reveal]] them at the fair.
They hoped the judges [[might:might]] [[uncover:uncover]] bright ideas and never coldly [[expose:expose]] weak points.
The old sea man chose a water [[domain:domain]] from the blue [[realm:realm]] he knew so well.
A small green [[foundation:foundation]] paid for the work, and the students [[specialise:specialised]] in cleaning water.
They would [[concentrate:concentrate]] each noon and [[utilise:utilise]] the rain jars behind the school.
Daily [[usage:usage]] stayed simple, so a shy [[tester:tester]] wrote notes after each [[trial:trial]].
Their very [[first:first]] [[device:device]] joined a [[kitchen:kitchen]] [[appliance:appliance]] to save water for plants.
The school yard offered free [[facility:facilities]] and shared [[equipment:equipment]] for the evening work.
Each sharp [[instrument:instrument]] and hand [[tool:tool]] stayed locked inside a [[wooden:wooden]] box.
A [[brass:brass]] [[gauge:gauge]] helped the students [[measure:measure]] the [[muddy:muddy]] water with [[steady:steady]] hands.
They would [[calculate:calculate]] the drops saved and [[compute:compute]] the costs on [[paper:paper]] after [[supper:supper]].
They could [[count:count]] the jars emptied and [[estimate:estimate]] the savings for the whole street.
Teachers came to [[assess:assess]] the build and [[evaluate:evaluate]] the drawings with kind smiles.
A [[spare:spare]] [[accessory:accessory]] came free, with a clean [[byproduct:byproduct]] for the garden soil.
An [[auxiliary:auxiliary]] [[tube:tube]] made the build more [[versatile:versatile]] for small homes.
The students would [[accumulate:accumulate]] old bottles and [[attach:attach]] them with strong [[string:string]] lines.
These glass jars [[belong:belong]] to the school lab that studies light and [[optics:optics]].
A school [[microscope:microscope]] showed the [[dirt:dirt]] clearly through its curved [[lens:lens]] at noon.
A toy [[radar:radar]] beeped softly, and its faint [[echo:echo]] amused the children by the [[fence:fence]].
A small [[sensor:sensor]] sent signals to a [[plain:plain]] [[multimedia:multimedia]] screen for everyone to see.
A safe [[network:network]] linked the rooms, and a [[round:round]] [[dial:dial]] set the water flow.
A borrowed [[laptop:laptop]] recorded the charts, while a big [[loudspeaker:loudspeaker]] called the breaks.
A cheap [[microphone:microphone]] caught the voices near an old [[cassette:cassette]] box of songs.
Sticky [[tape:tape]] held the wires [[tight:tight]], and [[binary:binary]] code blinked on the tiny screen.
A [[wireless:wireless]] link worked well, sending [[high-definition:high-definition]] pictures of the [[pond:pond]].
Clear [[audio:audio]] helped everyone hear, and a shared [[vision:vision]] kept the team brave and calm.
Their [[fantasy:fantasy]] grew wild, like happy [[science fiction:Science fiction]] about clean rivers.
A hand [[pump:pump]] lifted [[pond:pond]] water, while a tiny [[generator:generator]] lit a small lamp.
Each [[plastic:plastic]] [[gear:gear]] held firm, and the base could [[pivot:pivot]] toward the sun.
No [[hydraulic:hydraulic]] oil leaked, and the school [[drainage:drainage]] stayed dry all week.
Dirty [[sewage:sewage]] stayed apart, and fresh [[ventilation:ventilation]] kept the [[shed:shed]] sweet.
Wet leaves would be [[compress:compressed]], and steam would [[condense:condense]] on the cold lids.
Each seam was [[refine:refined]] again, and the tubes were [[simplify:simplified]] for easy daily care.
Grey water would be [[purify:purified]], and soup bits [[filter:filtered]] for the garden beds.
Drinking water was not [[distil:distilled]]; that [[mode:mode]] needed more heat and time.
The third [[prototype:prototype]] stood on a light [[wooden:wooden]] [[framework:framework]] near the gate.
Each new [[aspect:aspect]] looked fine, yet one [[phase:phase]] still leaked at [[night:night]].
Old Chen taught the students to [[operate:operate]] the spouts and [[facilitate:facilitate]] fast morning checks.
They could [[transform:transform]] [[ditch:ditch]] water and [[convert:convert]] it for the flower beds.
They did not [[alter:alter]] the roof path, but did [[shift:shift]] the jars to gather rain.
At [[dusk:dusk]] the [[crew:crew]] would [[turn:turn]] the valves and [[adapt:adapt]] the flows for [[thirsty:thirsty]] roots.
They would [[adjust:adjust]] the small screws and [[pinpoint:pinpoint]] drips with chalk marks.
The readings grew [[accurate:accurate]] and [[precise:precise]] after three calm [[trial:trial]] days.
Each [[correct:correct]] fitting saved water, and every fixed [[error:error]] taught them care.
One small [[mistake:mistake]] revealed a thin [[flaw:flaw]] in the lower left seam.
[[welcome home:Welcome home]] signs cheered the workers, hiding each small [[fault:fault]] with smiles.
A loose stone made Li [[stumble:stumble]], a dull [[contingency:contingency]] they soon fixed.
In hard [[circumstance:circumstances]] the old sea man stayed a true [[pioneer:pioneer]] for everyone.
No loud [[prophet:prophet]] promised wins, yet a kind [[herald:herald]] praised their [[steady:steady]] work.
The old man named Mei his [[heir:heir]] for the jars, and Lan his [[successor:successor]] for the notes.
Three school [[generation:generations]] joined, writing a shared [[surname:surname]] [[list:list]] on [[paper:paper]].
No one asked [[gender:gender]] questions; every [[pupil:pupil]] and [[spouse:spouse]] helper got the same tasks.
The kind old [[grandfather:grandfather]] and his tired [[father-in-law:father-in-law]] carried the heavy jars.
Each [[sibling:sibling]] brought a [[cousin:cousin]] to scrub bottles after lunch every day.
Little [[nephew:nephew]] Tao poured slowly, while [[niece:niece]] Ana held the funnel high.
They watched the bean [[embryo:embryos]] wake, just like a weak [[infant:infant]] opening its eyes.
A stray dog, a small [[orphan:orphan]], followed every [[juvenile:juvenile]] helper to the [[shed:shed]].
Each [[youngster:youngster]] shared bread, and [[youth:youth]] songs kept the long noon bright.
No noisy [[gang:gang]] blocked the path; [[teenage:teenage]] volunteers swept the [[lane:lane]] daily.
In bright [[adolescence:adolescence]] they learned much, helped by close [[kin:kin]] nearby.
Country [[folk:folk]] stopped to watch, and one far [[relative:relative]] sent seeds by post.
Close, [[intimate:intimate]] chats grew nightly, with [[dear:dear]] thanks for rice and tea.
Little Ying, a [[darling:darling]] of all, served cold tea to every plant [[lover:lover]].
Their [[beloved:beloved]] teacher [[madam:Madam]] Lin praised the neat joints and calm hands.
The smiling [[hostess:hostess]] poured tea, while the [[stern:stern]] [[landlady:landlady]] washed the cups.
The kind [[mistress:mistress]] of the yard and a busy [[housewife:housewife]] mopped the floor.
Old [[widow:widow]] Su sewed cloth bags, and a quick [[maid:maid]] rinsed the jars.
Its [[maiden:maiden]] [[trial:trial]] passed, pleasing the whole tired [[household:household]] at [[dusk:dusk]].
Each dull [[chore:chore]] felt light when the students sang, led by a funny [[host:host]].
The grey-haired [[landlord:landlord]] lent a [[shed:shed]], and his new [[tenant:tenant]] swept it clean.
Each [[guest:guest]] tasted the clean tea, and every shop [[customer:customer]] praised the clear water.
A shy [[client:client]] asked questions, and one brief [[encounter:encounter]] led to more help.
The students did not [[chase:chase]] stray dogs or [[miss:miss]] lunch while fixing the drips.
After each [[appointment:appointment]] with the judges, Mei would [[accompany:accompany]] Lin to the gate.
Small Bo, still [[dependent:dependent]] on crutches, dared to [[propose:propose]] a safer spout.
Their close [[engagement:engagement]] with the street felt sweet, longer than a short [[honeymoon:honeymoon]].
No row caused [[divorce:divorce]] in the team; everyone kept a [[single:single]] shared aim.
Mei took [[sole:sole]] care of the charts, and the others kept their [[respective:respective]] jars in line.
Each [[individual:individual]] wrote notes, even the tired [[commuter:commuter]] uncle from North Street.
The whole [[neighbourhood:neighbourhood]] clapped, even the [[stern:stern]] [[boss:boss]] from the tea shop.
A kind [[supervisor:supervisor]] praised the work, never scolding a slow [[subordinate:subordinate]] helper.
Lan chose Tao as her [[partner:partner]], too shy to [[mate:mate]] pigeons for the school show.
A sick [[colleague:colleague]] sent greetings, and a brave [[comrade:comrade]] brought soup at noon.
An old [[acquaintance:acquaintance]] smiled warmly, showing true [[affection:affection]] for the busy [[crew:crew]].
A kind [[stranger:stranger]] watched for a long while, then joined as an eager [[apprentice:apprentice]] helper.
The tired [[deputy:deputy]] head bowed to each small [[hero:hero]] of the street.
Rain fell softly over the [[quiet:quiet]] roofs and washed the dusty lanes at last.
A brave [[heroine:heroine]] from the [[drama:drama]] club and a shy [[actress:actress]] cheered loudly.
No [[stern:stern]] [[chancellor:chancellor]] visited, but a retired [[commander:commander]] sent a kind note.
The kind [[director:director]] of the fair stayed a firm [[proponent:proponent]] of school builds.
The fair [[committee:committee]] met twice, and the town [[council:council]] lent chairs and tables.
They chose Lan as [[delegate:delegate]], guided by a water [[specialist:specialist]] from South Street.
Children laughed aloud and shared warm buns with every [[guest:guest]] under the bright lamps.
A plant [[consultant:consultant]] and a kind [[veterinary:veterinary]] doctor praised the safe runoff.
The school [[counsellor:counsellor]] smiled, and a fair [[solicitor:solicitor]] explained the [[contest:contest]] rules clearly.
No [[stern:stern]] [[attorney:attorney]] argued, and a calm [[umpire:umpire]] timed each [[trial:trial]] fairly.
The busy [[cashier:cashier]] from the store and a tall [[fireman:fireman]] kept [[order:order]] near the spouts.
A [[gentle:gentle]] [[nurse:nurse]] [[bound:bound]] an aching knuckle, while a cheerful [[gardener:gardener]] planted new seeds.
Morning sun dried the wet paths, and the students greeted the whole [[neighbourhood:neighbourhood]] with smiles.
The funny [[barber:barber]] promised free [[haircut:haircuts]] to the winners after the fair.
The old [[fisherman:fisherman]] grinned widely, while the kind [[butcher:butcher]] shared hot buns.
Boys learned to [[groom:groom]] the ponies gently; no shouting held patience [[hostage:hostage]] any more.
Years of hard [[toil:toil]] ended sweetly; even a poor [[beggar:beggar]] drank clean water.
Nobody lived as a tired [[slave:slave]] to thirst, and no [[coward:coward]] feared telling the truth.

他说，一天夜里一场突袭让人看清了豪言壮语背后巨大的痛苦。
他讲述了一场冬季战役，最后在结冰的河边打了最后一仗。
弟弟听到那场无声的挣扎和远处的爆炸，忍不住打了个寒战。
士兵们会炮轰镇子，飞机则在夜间飞来轰炸桥梁。
每一次爆炸都震碎窗户，吓得小孩子们躲到桌子底下哭。
直到现在，炉边的一粒小火星仍在爷爷悲伤的记忆里闪烁。
他记得空旷田野里一辆毁坏的坦克散发出的火药味。
展厅里一门重炮静静立着，旁边躺着一枚小导弹。
爷爷轻轻地把一件旧武器和一把磨旧的手枪放回木箱。
旁边躺着一支生锈的步枪和一颗子弹，是那些岁月留下的伤感纪念。
最后他指着旧靶子，它曾帮炮弹偏转，护住附近的家园。
爷爷的第一个任务是送信，一盏灯暖暖的火焰为他引路。
一天傍晚，红色信号弹升起，点点亮光轻轻洒满夜空。
晚饭后，他就着柔和的微光慢慢擦拭自己的刀刃。
然后他把剑和旧斧放在安静的壁炉旁。
他曾用小锤子修好琴弓，让它在寒夜里奏出音乐。
多年后，一张弯箭和一杆长矛静静躺在教室布满灰尘的图画下。
一顶裂开的头盔和一面凹陷的盾牌并排安放在学校门上方。
好心的老师帮孩子们配备物品，还为疲惫的来访者准备热茶。
大厅能提供热汤，还在门口安排了友好的帮手。
从那以后再没有石头砸中墙壁，也没有战鼓为行军的队伍擂响。
再没听过突然的袭击，也没有愤怒的拳头在门上砸出洞。
曾经砍柴的手，绝不会在怒气中刺伤朋友。
那个艰难的两难处境让爷爷全家多年陷于困苦之中。
每个暗藏的陷阱都源于贪婪首领间残酷的阴谋。

寒夜夺走了热饭，瘦弱的孩子们只好挨饿。
壮汉们跑来夺取粮食，沿着小巷追赶可怜的农夫。

每次突然的袭击只教会他们用平静耐心的话语回击恶意。
漫长的围困没能用饥饿围住小镇，一名年轻的哨兵守在门口。

头盔盾牌挂上校门，老师备茶送汤，校园里打斗从此绝迹。
阴谋与饥荒让全家陷于困境，夺粮追人，威胁冒犯着村民。
凶喊闯不进爱心小屋，围困失败，广场立起旧城门复制品。
枪声止息歌声停，智言劝阻青年，旧法禁枪，无人叛家。
反抗者拒斥叛徒夸赞，铁证驱散恐惧，和平意志愈发坚定。
动荡渐息希望生，聚会教人给骄怒设限，比赛改庆丰收。
宿敌化友共春耕，巧计循蓝图，警告与职责换来面包。
抗议驳斥谎言，真力源于援手；善行日日发生，巨变自来。
爷爷笑容抚平野蛮岁月；众人牺牲睡眠助邻里，埋葬骄傲。
白杨后葬礼静穆，航线犹存，舰队安眠，和平悄然生长。
军车不扰果园毒药难毁花园，险情预示灾难，恶语伤友谊。
玩笑误导晚课受扰，孩子不退缩；放下刀具，白鸽入云。
止吵弃口号除杂草，善意胜猜疑，书信留笑迎凯旋。
碑石像旁荣誉长存，护士事迹添光，夜巡化作友好守望。
牡丹丛中伪装褪色，地洞藏兔，将军分粮，士兵傍老兵歇。
理工学院请机修工指导创新，专利讲解后留待集市揭晓。
老海员选定用水课题，基金会资助，学生专攻雨水利用。
仪器锁箱量规测水，晚饭后算账估算，老师微笑来评估。
辅助管增功能，瓶罐细绳搭装置，显微镜雷达传感器齐上阵。
网络连通刻度盘调水，电脑喇叭磁带齐全，高清看池塘。
幻想如科幻奔放，泵抽水灯点亮，齿轮牢固排水干爽。
接缝修整灰水净化，原型立上木架，老陈教操作促检查。
沟水转化浇花坛，黄昏调阀定位滴漏，三天试验读数精准。
小错暴露裂痕被修好，老海员稳当先驱，梅兰接下衣钵。
三代同写姓氏名单，祖父搬罐，孩子看豆胚如婴儿初醒。
小狗孤儿也来帮忙，青少年扫巷，乡亲远亲夜里亲密畅谈。
小莹端茶待客，林老师夸手稳；女眷各司其职，首试通过。
主持人领唱杂活变轻，房东借棚客商夸水，梅陪林赴约。
拄拐小波提议安全水嘴，全街鼓掌，众人同守一个目标。
主管不骂下属，兰涛结伴送汤；陌生人当学徒，副手敬英雄。
雨洗小巷戏剧社喝彩，指挥官寄字条，兰当选代表获专家指导。
灯下分包子迎宾，律师讲规则裁判计时，护士包扎园丁播种。
晨阳晒干小路，理发师渔夫屠夫同庆，辛劳换来清水与勇气。

title: 身体与时间
zh: 备考的一天与奶奶的健康年，两卷读完。
paragraphs: Early each morning Leo does one kind [[deed:deed]] to [[accustom:accustom]] himself to waking up early.
When the [[alarm:alarm]] rings, he has learned to [[react:react]] fast and [[reflect:reflect]] calmly on yesterday.
Leo must [[bear:bear]] the cold morning air and [[adopt:adopt]] a firm plan for the long day.
A warm breakfast [[can:can]] [[nourish:nourish]] his body, while father helps [[mow:mow]] the [[grass:grass]] in front of the house.
Leo steps [[outside:outside]], [[exhale:exhales]] white breath into the cold air, and checks his daily food [[intake:intake]] plan.
A cup of hot milk [[can:can]] [[revive:revive]] his tired head, so he [[can:can]] [[survive:survive]] the busy morning.
The low sun sends a sharp [[glare:glare]], but Leo still catches a quick [[glimpse:glimpse]] of the bus.
He takes a quick [[glance:glance]] at his watch, then has a [[peep:peep]] down the long road between the trees.
His [[steady:steady]] [[gaze:gaze]] stays on the road while he tries to [[peer:peer]] through the light morning rain.
Last evening he had [[contemplate:contemplated]] the stars and [[stare:stared]] long at the [[night:night]] sky.
There he took an [[oath:oath]] and made a solemn [[vow:vow]] in silence.
He added one more [[pledge:pledge]], and somewhere a [[whistler:whistler]] sang softly to the morning.
Leo quickly [[reply:replies]] to his mother and [[notify:notifies]] his friend about the late bus.
He likes to [[assert:assert]] his idea clearly, then [[explain:explain]] the bus [[delay:delay]] calmly.
Two boys start a loud [[quarrel:quarrel]], but the driver stops the small [[dispute:dispute]] at once.
After the short [[argument:argument]], Leo must [[hasten:hasten]] on foot to reach the school gate.
A kind [[guard:guard]] seems to [[urge:urge]] him to run, and does not [[scold:scold]] him for being late.
Leo will not [[curse:curse]] his bad luck, nor [[swear:swear]] at the heavy [[traffic:traffic]].
A rude shout could [[provoke:provoke]] ire, but the teacher only wishes to [[preach:preach]] patience.
Leo never [[boast:boasts]] about his scores, and never [[tease:teases]] his tired classmates.
Nobody will [[mock:mock]] his accent, and many friends will [[clap:clap]] for his short speech.
Classmates loudly [[applaud:applaud]] his effort as he tries to [[catch:catch]] every useful word.
He does not [[snatch:snatch]] other people's books, nor [[grab:grab]] pens from shared desks.
Leo wants to [[overtake:overtake]] his old self and keep a firm [[grip:grip]] on his daily habits.
Before class the [[mess:mess]] is cleaned up, and the [[twist:twist]] in the rope is undone.
Each [[fold:fold]] in the papers is smoothed out, with nothing left to [[scatter:scatter]].
Every [[fasten:fastening]] is checked twice, so nothing is left to [[loosen:loosen]].
No desk will be [[smash:smashed]] in a fit of ire, and no wall [[scratch:scratched]] by an angry pen.
Mud is [[scrape:scraped]] from the shoes, and the old classroom windows are [[polish:polished]] till they shine.
The cleaning tasks are [[split:split]] evenly, while the trees [[sway:sway]] gently [[outside:outside]] the window.
His [[phone:phone]] starts to [[vibrate:vibrate]] softly, while [[dust:dust]] seems to [[whirl:whirl]] in the warm light.
The fan blades [[rotate:rotate]] slowly above, as Leo feels his tired head [[reel:reel]].
At lunchtime students [[shuffle:shuffle]] their feet, but never [[collide:collide]] in the [[narrow:narrow]] hall.
Leo likes to [[combine:combine]] rice with vegetables and [[integrate:integrate]] [[fruit:fruit]] into his lunch.
The smell of good food seems to [[penetrate:penetrate]] the whole hall and [[pierce:pierce]] his sleepy afternoon mood.
He [[insert:inserts]] his meal card quickly and [[tilt:tilts]] the [[tray:tray]] a little to keep it [[steady:steady]].
After lunch the friends [[tow:tow]] the ball bag together and follow the dusty [[trail:trail]] to the courts.
They help [[arrange:arrange]] the cones in lines and learn to [[manipulate:manipulate]] the ball well.
The coach teaches Leo to [[steer:steer]] his runs, and hot sweat [[baptise:baptises]] his shirt in the sun.
Nobody wants to [[bet:bet]] money on the game or put pride at [[stake:stake]] after school.
They will not [[gamble:gamble]] with safety, but only share a fair [[promise:promise]] to play clean.
Fast games always [[attract:attract]] many students, yet Leo never [[obsess:obsesses]] over the final score.
[[smooth:Smooth]] moves [[can:can]] [[mesmerize:mesmerize]] the young fans, but missing shots feels like a short [[nightmare:nightmare]].
Leo [[can:can]] [[amaze:amaze]] his team with clever passes, and they [[marvel:marvel]] at his quick footwork.
His high [[jump:jump]] [[can:can]] [[astonish:astonish]] the tall rivals and [[involve:involve]] every friend in loud cheers.
A bad call may [[annoy:annoy]] the tired players, but it must not [[upset:upset]] their friendly mood.
Strange rules [[can:can]] [[bewilder:bewilder]] new players — that is the small [[irony:irony]] of street games.
Leo hates the [[indignity:indignity]] of cheating and shows [[contempt:contempt]] for rude [[foul:foul]] play.
He shows no [[neglect:neglect]] for the [[training:training]] rules and no [[disregard:disregard]] for the coach's voice.
Playing in [[ignorance:ignorance]] of the rules reveals [[bias:bias]] and often brings needless fouls.
Leo will not [[deviate:deviate]] from fair play, so he never faces orders to [[expel:expel]] him from the court.
He will not [[flee:flee]] from strong rivals, nor [[bully:bully]] smaller kids on the [[court:court]].
The last seconds [[can:can]] bring [[panic:panic]], but loud shouts should never [[terrify:terrify]] the young players.
Thoughts of [[revenge:revenge]] for last [[loss:loss]] cannot [[kidnap:kidnap]] his calm and friendly mood.
Nobody [[can:can]] [[hijack:hijack]] the happy game or [[smuggle:smuggle]] bad feelings into the team.
In the stories they read, fair judges [[convict:convict]] the cheaters, while stress tries to [[strangle:strangle]] the fun.
It was no bloody [[massacre:massacre]] of scores, only a fair [[decimation:decimation]] of old fears.
The coach may [[intervene:intervene]] to stop fights that [[impede:impede]] their happy games on the court.
[[victory:Victory]] has a strong [[allure:allure]], but sweet words are only [[bait:bait]] for heedless young minds.
Kind cheers [[can:can]] [[induce:induce]] fresh energy and never [[tempt:tempt]] players toward rude tricks.
After the games, teachers [[designate:designate]] reading zones and [[assign:assign]] pages for [[night:night]] study.
Helpers [[distribute:distribute]] clean [[worksheet:worksheets]] and quickly [[despatch:despatch]] messages to late teammates.
To [[detach:detach]] the tag means to [[undo:undo]] the small [[knot:knot]] with care.
Leo would not [[conceal:conceal]] the truth, nor [[disguise:disguise]] his true feelings.
No one should [[exclude:exclude]] others, or [[refuse:refuse]] help when it is needed.
He would [[assure:assure]] her, and never [[reverse:reverse]] his decision.
Leo will [[undertake:undertake]] extra listening drills that clearly [[stipulate:stipulate]] daily time limits.
Good scores [[can:can]] [[convince:convince]] his father and [[reassure:reassure]] his worried family at home.
Leo learns to [[aspire:aspire]] high and to control wild [[desire:desire]] for games and phones.
He seems to [[yearn:yearn]] for broad knowledge, and often [[invoke:invoke]] great examples from the past.
An [[inner:inner]] [[itch:itch]] for [[progress:progress]] drives each new [[attempt:attempt]] at the hard listening tasks.
Leo will [[strive:strive]] each evening and slowly [[fulfil:fulfil]] his weekly study plan.
A hard week [[loom:looms]] ahead, but Leo stays calm and begins to [[sort:sort]] his cards by topic.
To [[commence:commence]] well is to [[launch:launch]] the day with a clear [[purpose:purpose]].
He would not [[exploit:exploit]] others, but [[explore:explore]] new paths of his own.
If you [[exert:exert]] real effort, you [[tackle:tackle]] each [[challenge:challenge]] head-on.
He learned to [[cope:cope]] with stress and to [[dispose:dispose]] of useless worry.
His [[conduct:conduct]] stayed honest, with nothing important left to [[omit:omit]].
He [[erase:erases]] wrong answers quickly and [[rescue:rescues]] useful ideas from past mistakes.
Leo will [[recover:recover]] his strength with short walks, rather than [[resort:resorting]] to long naps.
Warm tea [[can:can]] [[restore:restore]] calm focus and help [[rectify:rectify]] small grammar slips.
Extra practice [[can:can]] [[redeem:redeem]] past lazy days and [[offset:offset]] weak spelling skills.
Fresh [[fruit:fruit]] [[can:can]] [[replenish:replenish]] his energy and help him [[obtain:obtain]] [[steady:steady]] evening focus.
The [[library:library]] [[can:can]] [[supply:supply]] [[quiet:quiet]] desks that [[offer:offer]] warm light for long reading.
Tutors [[can:can]] [[render:render]] hard lessons simple and [[enlarge:enlarge]] small steps into big gains.
Pictures [[can:can]] [[augment:augment]] dull texts and [[magnify:magnify]] tiny details for tired eyes.
Microphones [[can:can]] [[amplify:amplify]] soft voices, but teachers never [[exaggerate:exaggerate]] a student's small errors.
Short breaks are never [[prolong:prolonged]] too long, and Leo [[uphold:upholds]] firm sleeping hours.
Saved notes act as a strong [[backup:backup]] and [[can:can]] [[propel:propel]] Leo toward higher bands.
Leo will [[update:update]] his word lists nightly and slowly [[raise:raise]] his practice [[test:test]] scores.
Rain may [[leak:leak]] through the old windows and [[spill:spill]] cold water onto the [[wooden:wooden]] desks.
[[damp:Damp]] air can [[seep:seep]] through the cracks and make the old paint [[ooze:ooze]] with moisture.
Students need not [[evacuate:evacuate]] the hall, but they must avoid the [[muddy:muddy]] [[trench:trench]] near the gates.
Heavy rain [[can:can]] [[saturate:saturate]] shoes quickly — a fair [[excuse:excuse]] for arriving a little late.
Teachers will [[forgive:forgive]] the late arrivals and help young minds [[contain:contain]] worry and fright.
Leo shows deep [[regard:regard]] for the cleaners, and never uses lies to [[flatter:flatter]] his teachers.
He does not blindly [[worship:worship]] high scores, nor fight for a [[narrow:narrow]] [[cause:cause]].
For the [[sake:sake]] of his family's love, Leo keeps a clear study [[purpose:purpose]].
Each small [[objective:objective]] [[can:can]] slowly [[arouse:arouse]] fresh hope in his tired heart.
A low score may [[trigger:trigger]] worry, but Leo will still [[seek:seek]] wise help.
He [[can:can]] [[retrieve:retrieve]] old notes fast, and let the results [[testify:testify]] to his hard work.
Leo will [[verify:verify]] his answers twice and [[specify:specify]] a clear time for each task.
Good books [[can:can]] [[enlighten:enlighten]] young minds and warmly [[impart:impart]] timeless study skills.
Hard workers truly [[deserve:deserve]] good bands, and never let their focus [[drop:drop]] at [[night:night]].
Leo will not let hope [[sink:sink]] low, nor let scores [[plummet:plummet]] after lazy nights.
He learns to [[muffle:muffle]] the [[phone:phone]] noise, so stress cannot [[overshadow:overshadow]] his calm thinking.
At [[dawn:dawn]] he will [[greet:greet]] his mother and proudly [[salute:salute]] the morning flag.
Teachers will [[congratulate:congratulate]] his [[progress:progress]], and kind elders will [[bless:bless]] his brave path.
Leo wants to [[participate:participate]] in contests before waving a last [[farewell:farewell]] to his fears.
He will [[assort:assort]] his notes by color, so that each answer still [[correspond:corresponds]] to its question.
The teachers act in kind [[accord:accord]] with the rules, and [[attribute:attribute]] his gains to [[steady:steady]] effort.
Leo [[can:can]] [[recall:recall]] the morning words well, and quietly [[recollect:recollect]] the evening grammar rules.
Short cards [[can:can]] [[remind:remind]] him of phrases, so he [[can:can]] [[retell:retell]] stories simply.
Leo will [[repeat:repeat]] key sentences aloud and write a calm [[retrospect:retrospect]] of the day each night.
[[steady:Steady]] habits [[can:can]] [[impress:impress]] the sternest judges and help Leo [[surmount:surmount]] his final [[test:test]] fears.
Small failures need not [[mortify:mortify]] young hearts, while calm hope [[can:can]] [[pervade:pervade]] the room.
To [[replace:replace]] the old part is to [[substitute:substitute]] it entirely.
He learned to [[differentiate:differentiate]] truth from lies, and to [[distinguish:distinguish]] friends from [[foe:foes]].
He would not [[incline:incline]] toward [[anger:anger]], nor [[lean:lean]] on excuses.
At last Leo turns [[sideways:sideways]] to smile at the moon, and then falls asleep with hope.
Grandma used to lose her [[temper:temper]] quickly, yet she always spoke in a soft [[manner:manner]] at home.
Her calm [[attitude:attitude]] shows her warm and kind [[personality:personality]] to us all.
Patience is her best [[trait:trait]], and kindness is her greatest [[virtue:virtue]] in life.
Her smile is her special [[feature:feature]], though age has bent her back and left her [[stature:stature]] smaller than before.
She likes to say that the [[flesh:flesh]] is weak — and that is true for all [[mankind:mankind]].
The doctor said the [[bone:bone]] in her leg has grown soft, and Grandpa jokes that he is still the [[backbone:backbone]] of our house.
On the wall chart the full [[skeleton:skeleton]] and the [[round:round]] [[skull:skull]] show up very clearly.
A strong [[brain:brain]] needs good sleep, and a calm [[mind:mind]] needs love every day.
Grandma needs both [[physical:physical]] care and warm [[mental:mental]] support from the family.
The [[nurse:nurse]] touches her red [[cheek:cheek]] and warm [[forehead:forehead]] with [[gentle:gentle]] hands.
Sweat stands on her [[brow:brow]], and tears hang on her long [[eyelash:eyelashes]] that morning.
Her dry [[lip:lips]] are bitten, and she asks for more [[space:space]] to breathe in the room.
She puts out her [[tongue:tongue]], and the doctor looks deep into her red [[throat:throat]] quickly.
She lifts her small [[chin:chin]] to answer loudly, remembering the green [[gorge:gorge]] where she lived as a girl.
Her stiff [[jaw:jaw]] aches a little, so she slowly moves her long [[neck:neck]] left and right.
Grandpa strokes his grey [[beard:beard]] and lays his hand softly on her shaking [[shoulder:shoulder]].
Her tired [[limb:limb]] feels heavy, and she rests her aching [[elbow:elbow]] on the edge of the table.
The [[nurse:nurse]] holds her thin [[wrist:wrist]] and asks her to press down hard with her [[thumb:thumb]] for a strength [[test:test]].
Grandma opens her warm [[palm:palm]] and points with one shaking [[finger:finger]] at the chart.
The [[first:first]] check is to listen to her broad [[chest:chest]] with a black [[tube:tube]].
Then the doctor presses her soft [[abdomen:abdomen]] and counts each lower [[rib:rib]] one by one.
He ties a [[band:band]] [[round:round]] her thin [[waist:waist]].
Then the [[echo:echo]] waves show every [[inner:inner]] [[organ:organ]].
He says her [[liver:liver]] looks [[fine:fine]], but her empty [[stomach:stomach]] needs warm food every day.
Years ago her [[womb:womb]] carried my mother, and now one [[kidney:kidney]] no longer works as well as before.
Her left [[lung:lung]] sounds a bit low, and one small [[gland:gland]] feels bigger than before.
The scan shows the [[chamber:chambers]] of her heart, and food now moves slowly through her long [[intestine:intestine]].
She rubs her thick [[thigh:thigh]] and bends each stiff [[joint:joint]] to show us where it aches.
A warm [[blanket:blanket]] lies over her [[lap:lap]], covering her thick [[ankle:ankle]] and tired feet.
She lifts her aching [[heel:heel]] and wiggles each little [[toe:toe]] to make us laugh.
Every thin [[muscle:muscle]] needs daily walks, and every tiny [[pore:pore]] needs fresh air too.
The [[nurse:nurse]] feels her slow [[pulse:pulse]] and says every red [[artery:artery]] still carries blood well.
Every thin [[nerve:nerve]] sends quick signals, and every small [[hormone:hormone]] sways her moods.
Walking together in the morning is a [[gentle:gentle]] [[stimulus:stimulus]] that keeps the [[immune:immune]] [[guard:guard]] strong.
Her sleep [[biorhythm:biorhythm]] changed last [[spring:spring]], and her poor [[eyesight:eyesight]] makes reading hard.
The [[visual:visual]] chart is simple, and every letter stays clearly [[visible:visible]] from far away.
Her answers come out [[vague:vague]], not [[dumb:dumb]], for she feels shy before strangers.
The [[aural:aural]] [[test:test]] goes well, and a quick [[dental:dental]] check shows clean teeth too.
She stays [[awake:awake]] till ten, and never tries to hide a big [[yawn:yawn]] late at [[night:night]].
A short [[nap:nap]] at noon helps her rest, but she never likes to [[doze:doze]] off after dinner.
She loves a [[quiet:quiet]] room at noon, for loud noise [[can:can]] [[cripple:cripple]] her daytime rest.
She once feared she would be [[lame:lame]] forever, until she saw how one tall tree [[can:can]] [[dwarf:dwarf]] the small [[grass:grass]] at its foot.
Mum recalls the days of her [[pregnancy:pregnancy]] long ago, when Dad made a silly joke about a thin [[condom:condom]] at a health talk.
The doctor sends her blood for a careful [[clone:clone]] test of her cells, finds no [[error:error]], and notes each small [[symptom:symptom]] with care.
No serious [[disease:disease]] shows on the scans, yet a [[mild:mild]] [[illness:illness]] makes her cough at [[night:night]].
She never lets out a [[moan:moan]], though a [[mild:mild]] [[infection:infection]] gives her cold sweats.
Smoking is a clear [[detriment:detriment]] to good health, and a bad fall [[can:can]] leave a [[broken:broken]] arm.
Too much sugar [[can:can]] [[disable:disable]] a strong person, leaving her feeling like an [[invalid:invalid]] for weeks.
As a calm [[patient:patient]], she tells the [[nurse:nurse]] about her sleep [[dysfunction:dysfunction]] in detail.
No sign of [[diabetes:diabetes]] shows up today, and no sign of [[obesity:obesity]] worries the [[nurse:nurse]] either.
She is not [[overweight:overweight]] at all, though [[mild:mild]] [[hypertension:hypertension]] calls for daily checks.
Fright [[can:can]] [[paralyse:paralyse]] an old body, leaving it shaking and [[dizzy:dizzy]] for hours.
Worry is strange but not [[insane:insane]], yet long [[insomnia:insomnia]] [[can:can]] [[steal:steal]] her [[night:night]] rest away.
She has no food [[allergy:allergy]], and the scan shows no sign of [[heart attack:heart attack]] [[risk:risk]] now.
No [[trace:trace]] of [[cancer:cancer]] shows up in her tests, though [[mild:mild]] [[arthritis:arthritis]] stiffens her hands a little.
The doctor [[saw:saw]] no sign of [[stroke:stroke]] at all, and even the small [[pimple:pimple]] on her nose has faded.
No [[plague:plague]] walks our streets today, and only a [[mild:mild]] [[flu:flu]] visits each winter term.
Her [[mild:mild]] [[fever:fever]] fell last [[night:night]], and her dull [[headache:headache]] left with the morning tea.
Her foot did not [[swell:swell]] any more, and dry food never makes her [[choke:choke]] at meals.
A [[slip:slip]] [[can:can]] [[injure:injure]] an old person who walks slowly, so we [[guard:guard]] her from any [[injury:injury]] on rainy days.
If she falls she may [[hurt:hurt]] herself, but her skin does not [[bleed:bleed]] often now.
A dark [[bruise:bruise]] faded on her arm, leaving only a thin white [[scar:scar]].
We clean each small [[wound:wound]] softly, for we worry about any deep [[trauma:trauma]] inside her.
No hard [[lump:lump]] has grown on her arm, and she feels no sharp [[pain:pain]] during the walk.
We never speak of [[death:death]] at home, for every [[mortal:mortal]] life feels precious to us.
We do not [[dread:dread]] a sad [[demise:demise]], nor do we wait each day for dismal [[doom:doom]].
No [[fatal:fatal]] [[crash:crash]] has touched our street, and no [[lethal:lethal]] smoke has entered our home.
The doctor keeps a [[corpus:corpus]] of health [[record:records]], and warns his tired colleagues against [[overwork:overwork]].
Long stairs make her legs [[tire:tire]], and smoky buses [[exhaust:exhaust]] her every morning.
[[mild:Mild]] [[fatigue:fatigue]] comes after lunch, but she never [[faint:faints]] on our walks.
Her steps felt [[feeble:feeble]] yesterday, for the long wait left her [[weary:weary]] and pale.
Hunger [[can:can]] [[weaken:weaken]] her arms fast, and cold seats feel [[uncomfortable:uncomfortable]] against her spine.
She had never fallen [[unconscious:unconscious]] before, though a [[chronic:chronic]] cough stayed for months.
No [[acute:acute]] cough troubles her now, only a light [[sore:sore]] spot on her arm after the rain.
So we hide our [[sorrow:sorrow]] behind smiles, and share less of our [[suffering:suffering]] with Grandma each day.
We hear no sad [[lament:lament]] at home now — only music for morning [[therapy:therapy]].
Good [[health care:health care]] starts at home, with clean [[sanitary:sanitary]] habits every day.
Warm soup is [[curative:curative]] late at [[night:night]], and daily [[hygiene:hygiene]] keeps colds away.

对康复太慢的怒气已渐渐散去，他也不再为错过的学校远足而暴怒。
安娜平静的微笑抚平了他的皱眉，也教他不憋闷火、不喊不叫地面对耽搁。
吵闹的公交车似乎再也惹不恼他，他也不去恨楼梯上那点缓慢的进步。
他放下了对久等的憎恨，把飞虫只当成小小的麻烦，而不是什么大不了的事。
发苦的汤没让他脸上露出一丝嫌弃，晚点的公交车也扰乱不了他平和的心情。
他请孩子们别去骚扰那些瘦弱的鸭子，也别去打扰在墙边睡觉的老猫。
雨后的泥鞋子让人心烦，却远不如独自卧床的那几个星期难受。
连令人不快的取药长队也走得飞快，尽管不利的风把诊所的窗户吹得咔咔作响。
如今没有一个邻居面带敌意，队伍不长的时候林也从不会愤愤不平。
安娜建议了一份大胆全新的阅读书单，而不是一周十本的疯狂赶读。
湿石头上又野又疯的游戏被禁止了，那些弄伤小孩子的恶毒把戏也不许再玩。
没有流浪狗凶狠地咬人，男孩们也不隔着安静的湖面喊粗话。
没有孩子写刻薄的纸条，林则靠每天做家务，管住自己渐渐膨胀的自负。
他拒绝了独吞所有颜料的自私念头，也从不跟动作慢的伙伴说难听的话。
林不再冒冒失失地冲过马路，也学着在爬完陡坡之后，让起伏不定的心情平复下来。
怪异的梦在天亮时散去，他也戒掉了伤害睡眠的过量夜宵。
对考试的旧焦虑又回来了，让林坐在椅子上坐立难安，一直到午饭时分。
长篇发言之前他仍会紧张不安，但他直面了自己害怕朗读的旧恐惧，一口一口慢慢呼吸。
从前胆小的男孩如今不再大惊小怪，咧着嘴笑，在门口迎客。
他从不对跑得慢的人说侮辱的话，也没有从大男孩那里学来刻薄的顺口溜。
林不羡慕游得快的孩子，也不嫉妒好友赢走的奖。
他对数字的旧疑虑散了，看老师的眼光里也没有了阴暗的猜疑。
起初林对网课将信将疑，说那微弱的音质是学习路上不达标的一道坎。
那把旧椅子坐着摇摇晃晃没法学习，昏暗的角落似乎也不适合深夜读书。
帮奶奶做事林从不推辞，虽然有一次他不太乐意去洗青菜。
分面包他从不犹豫，只有吃掉最后一个甜面包时才觉得有点内疚。
响亮的打嗝曾让他在班里难为情，可小小的失手并没有让他深深懊悔。
说了粗话林会很快悔过，若伤了梅柔软的心，他更是打心底里羞愧。
他对着旧照片轻轻叹了口气，却保证再也不独自坐在台阶上流泪了。
安娜教大家安静地包容学得慢的同学，这也改变了林对新同学那种无知的看法。
林学会忍受长长的康复散步，路过那只曾偷喝热奶的狡黠小猫。
故事里的狐狸看起来狡猾又机灵，他们游戏的规则却从不显得随意松散。
在安娜的屋里，没有哪个问题显得可笑，黑板上的错误也不显得愚蠢。
他最初的舞步别扭又笨拙，但音乐轻轻托着他滑过地板。
林不再粗心地把书丢在雨里，也不再对公园上空的湿云视而不见。
全班要去参观之前，那家小诊所赶在午饭前给梅打了一针疫苗。
在诊所里，他们听说山里的新鲜空气曾帮一位村民治好了肺结核。
年长的护士笑着说，一个孩子喉咙痛又发烧，是种奇怪的综合征。
她还回忆起大流行那阵子，孩子们都把课桌搬到了厨房的餐桌上。
她提醒大家，充足的睡眠和温热的食物能帮疲惫的身体筑起更强的免疫力。
在病房门口，探视的人把手洗上两遍，不让埃博拉有机可乘。
奶奶在家总把水烧开，因为霍乱曾在她们村里传播过。
她还说，哮喘一复发，陈就会起身靠在敞开的窗边。
每当轻微的不适让安娜眼睛发酸，她就会停下来休息。
淘气的小狗天天咬拖鞋，午饭时却从不贪吃。
诊所边刺耳的喇叭声很突兀，懒散的午后则渐渐变成轻快的散步。
林甩掉清晨懒洋洋的劲儿，一时兴起，到河边去画画。
他那张死板的旧时刻表松动了，奶奶却仍固执地坚持饭后要喝热茶。
林打破了体弱病人一蹶不振的刻板印象，每月在诊所大厅分享自己的画。
诊所每季度办一次读书秀，最后汇成每年春天的一场盛大集市。
林每年的复查正好赶在他的生日那一周，看病于是变成了庆祝新生的欢乐周年。
学习的新纪元开始了，林送给安娜一件用绿纸包着的小礼物。
他们读当代的城市故事，也读吟咏远山的中世纪短歌谣。
老师讲起上个千年的变迁，说是一百万个细小的脚步塑造了城镇。
她先给大家看沙漠上空十亿颗星星的照片，随后又和孩子们分了一打热乎乎的包子。
黎明时林在水边慢跑，到了正午，又回到高高树荫下休息。
午夜没有为读书点灯，夜雨却整夜轻轻敲着铁皮屋顶。
每天晚上林早早合上书，把英文笔记保持得又新又整齐，等着第二天上课。
他立刻回复安娜，珍惜着长久沉默之后每一瞬间的夸奖。
凭着从前画许多素描练出的功夫，林帮一位从前的病友在湖边画鸟。
前一周他天天读书，为镇上的新学者立下了一个好先例。
最重要的一课是耐心，翻开的第一页是日出时宁静的湖。
起初林加入了初级组，后来搬去放长篇故事的中级书架。
考试正酣他仍保持平静，在散步和吃饭的间隙读诗度过那段时间。
与此同时，梅在附近学吉他，鼓声笛声同时在傍晚的大厅里回荡。
林加入了一个一直在办的读书会，它让他在校园之外生出对故事永恒的热爱。
他在窗边留了一个固定书桌，每天早晨洗好手、准时到达。
整个春天林天天读书，一口气接连读完了三本书。
安娜定期检查他的功课，在学校生日演出临近之前，夸奖他的成长。
说也凑巧，林在那里遇见了一位老护士，她看着他稳健向前的脚步，笑了。
